title: Selective Retrieval Routing for Multi-Violation Knowledge Graph Repair
abstract: arXiv:2611.07342v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Knowledge graphs often contain missing or inconsistent facts that undermine the applications built on them. Schema validation detects such violations but does not identify which of several valid repairs recovers the intended graph. External corpora can supply the evidence needed to identify the intended repair, but retrieving from them is costly and not always successful. We propose a framework for selective retrieval in iterative graph repair. An LLM repair agent explores and edits the graph, while a router controls its access to a researcher agent that retrieves external evidence. We extend a violation-injection framework to generate cases with multiple compatible violations and known reference repairs. The agent's repair outcomes on these cases provide supervision for training the deployment-specific router. translated_title: 面向多重违规知识图谱修复的选择性检索路由
translated_abstract: 知识图谱通常包含缺失或不一致的事实，这会损害构建在其之上的应用。模式验证能够检测此类违规，但无法确定多种有效修复方案中哪一种能够恢复预期的图谱。外部语料库可以提供识别预期修复所需的证据，但从中检索的成本高昂且并不总是成功。我们提出了一个面向迭代图谱修复中选择性检索的框架：一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的修复智能体负责探索和编辑图谱，同时一个路由器控制其访问负责检索外部证据的研究员（researcher）智能体的权限。我们扩展了一个违规注入框架，以生成包含多个兼容违规和已知参考修复的案例，智能体在这些案例上的修复结果为训练特定部署场景的路由器提供了监督信号。在两个楼宇自动化数据集上的实验表明，研究员智能体的访问对某些违规能改善修复效果，而对另一些违规则会降低效果……
tldr: 该论文提出一种选择性检索路由框架，由LLM修复智能体编辑知识图谱、路由器智能控制对外部证据检索的访问，并利用违规注入生成的修复结果训练特定部署的路由器，从而提升多重违规知识图谱的修复效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a selective retrieval routing framework in which an LLM repair agent edits the knowledge graph, a deployment-specific router controls its access to external evidence retrieval, and the router is trained using repair outcomes from violation-injected cases, improving multi-violation knowledge graph repair.
